gettingAround.en: A driving trip. Times are local. Keep bags in the trunk at trailheads.
gettingAround.zh: 这是一趟自驾。时间都是当地时间。停在步道口时，行李放进行李箱。

title.en: Thanksgiving: land in Phoenix, turkey lunch at Rock Springs at 1:30, Bell Rock, sunset at Airport Mesa, dinner at Rascal
title.zh: 感恩节 · 落地 Phoenix → Rock Springs 火鸡午餐（1:30）→ Bell Rock → Airport Mesa 日落 → Rascal 晚餐

notes.en: Land at Terminal 4 and collect checked bags if you have them
notes.zh: 落地 T4，取托运行李（如有）

note.zh: T4 出口跟 'PHX Sky Train' 标志 → 坐到 Rental Car Center 站（免费，约 5–8 分钟一班），出站即 Avis 柜台

notes.en: Pick up the car at 12:00 PM. The driver brings a physical license and a physical credit card
notes.zh: 取车（订单 12:00 PM 取；主驾，带实体驾照+实体信用卡+）

note.zh: I-17 N 约 40 mi → Exit 242（Black Canyon City）→ 右转 Old Black Canyon Hwy 1 分钟

notes.en: Thanksgiving lunch, table at 1:30 PM. The plate is served 11 AM–3 PM. Choose a pie at PieBox afterward
notes.zh: 感恩节午餐（订 1:30 PM；套餐 11 AM–3 PM），饭后在 PieBox 挑派

hours.en: Official notice: Thanksgiving 11/26 turkey dinner 11 AM–3 PM
hours.zh: 官网公告：11/26 感恩节 11 AM–3 PM 火鸡大餐，建议订位

text.en: 1918 station building, fireplace, and stone steps by the creek garden
text.zh: 1918 年驿站老楼，壁炉+溪边花园石阶

text.en: PieBox bakery: watch the pies through the window
text.zh: PieBox 派铺：橱窗看烘焙

text.en: The Thanksgiving turkey plate includes a slice of pie
text.zh: 感恩节火鸡套餐自带一片派
Thanksgiving Dinner（11/26 限定套餐：turkey、garlic mashed potatoes、gravy、yams、cornbread stuffing、cranberry sauce、dinner roll + a slice of pie）
JD Pecan Pie（招牌 Jack Daniel's 山核桃派）

text.en: Banana Cream Pie / Apple Crumb Pie
text.zh: Banana Cream Pie / Apple Crumb Pie

backups.name: Matt's Big Breakfast (PHX T4, B concourse)
backups.nameEn: Matt's Big Breakfast (PHX T4, B concourse)

text.zh: The Chop & Chick（猪排+2 蛋）
Griddlecakes
Thanksgiving Day Menu（官网页面，菜品现场看）

note.zh: I-17 N → Exit 298 → AZ-179 N 约 8 mi → 右侧 Courthouse Vista / Bell Rock Trailhead 停车场；用 行程主人 的 America the Beautiful 年票挂后视镜即可（不用另买 Red Rock Pass）

notes.en: Walk Bell Rock Pathway to the base of the bell rock and see Courthouse Butte. Shortened to 25 minutes so sunset at Airport Mesa comes first
notes.zh: Bell Rock Pathway 走到钟形岩底部看 Courthouse Butte（缩短为 25 分钟，Airport Mesa 日落优先）

text.en: Bell Rock and Courthouse Butte in one frame
text.zh: 钟形岩正面+Courthouse Butte 双岩同框

text.en: Village of Oak Creek from the lower rock slope
text.zh: 下层岩坡上看 Village of Oak Creek 全景
Sedona 能量漩涡（vortex）点之一

note.zh: AZ-179 N → Y 形环岛左转 89A W → 左转 Airport Rd 上山 0.5 mi（感恩节下午 179 环岛常堵，预留 10 分钟）

notes.en: Sunset, about 5:14 PM on 11/26. A 10-minute walk up the start of Airport Loop reaches the saddle
notes.zh: 日落（11/26 日落约 5:14 PM）。可走 Airport Loop 起头 10 分钟到鞍部取景

text.en: Cathedral Rock, Bell Rock, and Thunder Mountain turning red at sunset, all in one view
text.zh: 360° 看 Cathedral Rock、Bell Rock、Thunder Mountain 被夕阳染红

text.en: Stay 15 minutes after sunset for blue hour
text.zh: 日落后 15 分钟的 'blue hour' 别急着走

text.en: One of Sedona's four main vortex sites
text.zh: Sedona 四大 vortex 之一

note.zh: Airport Rd 下山 → 89A W 1.5 mi → 右转进 The Wilde Resort

name.en: Rascal Modern American Diner & Bar (The Wilde Resort & Spa)
name.zh: Rascal Modern American Diner & Bar (The Wilde Resort & Spa)

notes.en: Thanksgiving dinner at 6:00 PM. There is a 15-minute grace period
notes.zh: 感恩节晚餐（6:00 PM；宽限 15 分钟）

hours.en: Confirmed. The Thanksgiving menu is on the official PDF
hours.zh: 已订；感恩节菜单已公布（官网 PDF）

text.zh: Roast Turkey Dinner（感恩节限定：Red Bird 火鸡、sage bread stuffing、green beans、whipped sweet potatoes、gravy、cranberry relish、dinner roll）
Butternut Squash Soup
Pumpkin Pie with Whipped Cream
Shrimp & Grits（常规晚餐菜单招牌，2022 'Best Twist on an Original'）
Thanksgiving Day Menu

note.zh: 车留在 The Wilde 停车场，沿 89A 人行道往西 300 m

notes.en: Photo stop at the turquoise M, the only one of its color. Leave after the picture
notes.zh: 拍照：全球唯一绿松石色 M 标志（拍完就走，不用吃）

hours.en: The sign can be photographed any time. Thanksgiving hours inside the shop were not checked
hours.zh: 招牌 24h 可拍（店内感恩节营业时间未核实）

text.en: Turquoise M. Sedona does not allow a yellow one
text.zh: 绿松石色 M（Sedona 市规不准用黄色）

note.zh: 走回 The Wilde 停车场取车
89A W 1 mi，右侧；酒店免费停车

notes.en: Check in for 2 nights. Bags stay in the trunk all day. At trailheads, put things in the trunk, not in sight
notes.zh: 入住（2 晚）。行李整天在后备箱：停步道口时把东西收进后备箱、不放车内显眼处

hours.en: Confirmed. The hotel said check-in is available from 3 PM
hours.zh: 已订（酒店回信 3 PM 起可入住）

notes.en: Thanksgiving: the Sedona shuttle, Chapel of the Holy Cross, and Montezuma Castle are closed, so none of them are on this day
notes.zh: 感恩节：Sedona Shuttle 停运、Chapel of the Holy Cross 闭馆、Montezuma Castle 闭馆 → 本日都不排

notes.en: Rock Springs table at 1:30 PM, arriving at 1:26. Bell Rock is shortened to 25 minutes. Sunset at Airport Mesa comes first
notes.zh: Rock Springs 订 1:30 PM（1:26 到）；Bell Rock 缩短为 25 分钟，Airport Mesa 日落优先

notes.en: Bags stay in the car. Put them in the trunk before a trailhead
notes.zh: 行李在车上：停步道口前把东西收进后备箱

notes.en: Sunset about 5:14 PM
notes.zh: 日落约 5:14 PM

title.en: Three-trail day in Sedona: Subway Cave in Boynton Canyon, Devil's Bridge on Route 11, lunch at Coffee Pot, Chapel of the Holy Cross, Cathedral Rock on Route 15, and Cowboy Club
title.zh: Sedona 三条步道日 · Subway Cave（Boynton Canyon）→ Devil's Bridge（Route 11）→ Coffee Pot 午餐 → Chapel of the Holy Cross → Cathedral Rock（Route 15）→ Cowboy Club

notes.en: Leave at 6:25. Skip a sit-down breakfast and bring a grab-and-go. Hang the America the Beautiful pass on the mirror
notes.zh: 6:25 出发（不吃坐下早餐，带 grab-and-go）；America the Beautiful 年票挂后视镜

note.zh: 89A W 0.2 mi → 右转 Dry Creek Rd 2.0 mi → 靠左上 Boynton Pass Rd 0.9 mi → T 字路口左转（往 Enchantment）1.6 mi → 右转进 Forest Service 停车场（Enchantment Resort 大门前）；Forest Service 小停车场（约 25–36 位，Black Friday 7:00–7:30 就满）；年票有效

notes.en: Boynton Canyon Trail No. 47. About 2 miles in, turn right behind the large alligator juniper onto an unmarked path, about 0.3–0.4 miles. People sometimes lay branches across it on purpose. The last stretch is steep slickrock. Use hands and feet to climb into the cave. About 5 miles round trip. Allow 2 hours 50 minutes, including parking, the restroom, and photos in the cave
notes.zh: Boynton Canyon Trail No. 47 → 约 2 mi 处左手边大棵 alligator juniper（鳄皮刺柏）后右转进无标志小路（约 0.3–0.4 mi，有人故意横放树枝）→ 最后一段陡滑的 slickrock 手脚并用爬进洞；往返约 5 mi，留 2 小时 50 分（含停车、厕所、洞里拍照）

hours.en: The trail is open all day. Sunrise is about 7:11 AM. It is still dark at 6:45, so use a headlamp or phone light for the first 20 minutes
hours.zh: 步道全天开放；日出约 7:11 AM，6:45 起步天还暗 → 带头灯/手机灯走前 20 分钟

text.en: The curved red-sandstone subway tunnel at the cave mouth. Stand inside and photograph the half-circle opening
text.zh: 洞口弧形红砂岩'地铁隧道'——站在洞内往外拍半圆形洞口

text.en: The Sinagua cliff dwelling beside the cave is about 800 years old. Look only. Do not touch, enter, or climb the walls. ARPA protects it
text.zh: 洞旁 Sinagua 古崖居遗址（800 年；只看不碰、不进、不爬墙，受 ARPA 法保护）

text.en: Red rock walls on both sides of Boynton Canyon, and Kachina Woman on the way back
text.zh: Boynton Canyon 两侧红岩壁 + 回程看 Kachina Woman 岩柱

note.zh: 出停车场左转 1.6 mi → 右转 Boynton Pass Rd 0.9 mi → 靠右 Dry Creek Rd 2.0 mi → 右转 89A W 1.1 mi → 左转 Upper Red Rock Loop Rd → 右侧 West SR-89A Park & Ride（905 号）；Park & Ride 免费
Route 11 每 :00 / :30 发车（免费）→ Dry Creek Vista 10:10

notes.en: About 6.4 km round trip, about 55 minutes each way. Start at 10:12, reach the bridge around 11:10, photograph until 11:45, then walk back to Dry Creek Vista for the 12:40 return bus
notes.zh: 往返约 6.4 km（单程约 55 分钟）。10:12 起步 → ~11:10 到桥 → 拍照到 11:45 → 走回 Dry Creek Vista 赶 12:40 回程车

hours.en: ⚠ On Black Friday the midday photo line is 40–60 minutes. If it is longer than 35 minutes at 11:10, do not wait. Photograph from beside or below the bridge. Leave the bridge at 11:45 for the 12:40 bus. 12:15 is the latest, which means the 1:10 bus and lunch to go. Coffee Pot closes at 2 PM
hours.zh: ⚠ Black Friday 中午排队 40–60 分钟：11:10 到桥时队伍 >35 分钟就别排，改在桥侧/桥下拍全景。 11:45 一定离开桥（赶 12:40 车）；最晚 12:15 离开 → 1:10 车（这样午餐只能外带，Coffee Pot 2 PM 关门）

text.en: Stand on the natural stone arch, Sedona's largest sandstone arch
text.zh: 站上天然石拱桥（Sedona 最大的砂岩拱）

text.en: Seven Sisters in the morning side light
text.zh: 清晨侧光下的 Seven Sisters 远景

text.en: A side path under the bridge for the photo of people on the arch
text.zh: 桥下侧路可拍'人在桥上'的全景

note.zh: 89A E 1.4 mi，左侧（Basha's 和 Safeway 之间）；店前免费停车

notes.en: Lunch, about 45 minutes. Breakfast is served all day, and lunch starts at 11 AM. Sign in at the door and wait. If it is crowded, order to go on the website
notes.zh: 午餐约 45 分钟（全天供应早餐，11 AM 起有午餐；到店先在门口签到候位）；人多就点外带（官网可网上点）

text.zh: #101 Jelly, Peanut Butter and Banana（101 号煎蛋卷，Elvis 传说那款）
#49 Green Chile and Cheese（青辣椒芝士煎蛋卷）
Huevos Rancheros（green chile sauce）
Roma 或 Blanco Classico（14" 招牌披萨；Blanco Classico 是 House favorite 白披萨）
Meat Lasagna
Hideaway Antipasto（House favorite 沙拉）
Chicken Mole' Enchiladas
Javelina Margarita（+prickly pear）

note.zh: 89A E → Y 环岛右转 AZ-179 S 3 mi → Chapel Rd 环岛左转 0.6 mi；停车只有 45 位，满了就坡顶下客

notes.en: Walk up the ramp into the chapel, stay quiet, then the outer terrace for the red rocks
notes.zh: 上坡道进礼拜堂（保持安静），再到外平台看红岩

hours.en: Daily 9 AM–5 PM. Last entry at 4:45
hours.zh: 每天 9 AM–5 PM（最后入场 4:45）

text.en: The 90-foot cross face set between two red-rock peaks
text.zh: 嵌在双峰红岩之间的 90 英尺十字立面

text.en: Floor-to-ceiling windows inside the chapel, facing the red-rock valley
text.zh: 礼拜堂内落地窗正对红岩谷

text.en: Terrace view of Bell Rock, Courthouse Butte, and Cathedral Rock
text.zh: 平台看 Bell Rock / Courthouse Butte / Cathedral Rock

note.zh: Chapel Rd → AZ-179 N 约 1.5 mi → 右侧 North SR-179 Park & Ride（1294 SR-179）；Park & Ride 免费
Route 15 每 15 分钟（:00/:15/:30/:45）→ Cathedral Rock 3:10

notes.en: 100 minutes on the trail. About 2 km round trip and about 225 m of climbing. The second half uses hands and feet. At 4:30 start down from the saddle for the 4:52 return bus. The 5:12 is the last bus and only a backup
notes.zh: 步道 100 分钟：往返约 2 km，爬升 ~225 m，后半段手脚并用； 4:30 一定从鞍部往下走，赶 4:52 回程车（5:12 是末班，只当备用）

hours.en: The shuttle runs on 11/27. Last Route 15 bus back is 5:12 PM
hours.zh: Shuttle 11/27 运行，Route 15 末班回程 5:12 PM（官网）

text.en: Cathedral spires close on both sides of the saddle
text.zh: 鞍部两侧红岩'大教堂'尖塔近在眼前

text.en: Village of Oak Creek and Bell Rock looking back
text.zh: 回望 Village of Oak Creek 与 Bell Rock

text.en: The walls are reddest from 4 to 5 PM. Sunset is about 5:14
text.zh: 下午 4–5 点岩壁最红（日落约 5:14）

note.zh: Route 15 回程 4:52（末班 5:12 只当备用，误了就要走 ~3 km 公路）
AZ-179 N → Y 环岛 → 89A W 3.5 mi → 酒店；回房换衣服（傍晚，非午休）

notes.en: Back to the room to wash up and change. This is the evening, not a midday break
notes.zh: 回房洗把脸、换衣服（傍晚）

note.zh: 89A E 4 mi → Uptown；停 Forest Rd 停车楼

notes.en: Dinner
notes.zh: 晚餐

hours.en: Official site: daily 11 AM–9 PM except Christmas. Seatings are 5:00 and 6:30 only
hours.zh: 官网：每天 11 AM–9 PM（圣诞除外）；订位仅 5:00 / 6:30

text.zh: Trail Boss Sampler（Cactus Fries、Rattlesnake Sausage、Bison Meatballs、BBQ Ribs + pretzel stick）
House Smoked Prime Rib（The Weekend Roast：周五–周日 4 PM 后限量）
Butcher's Cut of Bison（当日野牛部位，问服务员）
Famous Cowboy margarita + Prickly Pear

text.en: Côtelettes d'Agneau Roasted Double Lamb Chops
text.zh: Côtelettes d'Agneau Roasted Double Lamb Chops（三块双骨羊排）
French Onion Soup Gratinee
Flaming Bananas Foster（桌边点火甜点）
Elote
Smoked Pork Cheeks
Lamb Adobo

note.zh: 89A W 4 mi 回酒店

notes.en: Leave at 6:25 for Boynton Canyon. There is no shuttle, so drive. On Black Friday the lot is full by 7:00–7:30, so arrive at 6:40. No sit-down breakfast. Bring a grab-and-go
notes.zh: 6:25 出发去 Boynton Canyon（无 shuttle，自驾）；停车场 Black Friday 7:00–7:30 就满 → 6:40 到；坐下早餐取消，带 grab-and-go

notes.en: Subway Cave is in the Red Rock–Secret Mountain Wilderness. No drones. Look at the cliff dwelling beside the cave and do not touch it
notes.zh: Subway Cave 在 Red Rock–Secret Mountain Wilderness 内： 无人机；洞旁古崖居只看不碰

notes.en: Devil's Bridge: the midday photo line is 40–60 minutes. Leave the bridge at 11:45 for the 12:40 bus. 12:15 is the latest, for the 1:10 bus, and then lunch is to go
notes.zh: Devil's Bridge：中午拍照排队 40–60 分钟 → 11:45 离开桥（赶 12:40 车）；最晚 12:15 离开（1:10 车，午餐改外带）

notes.en: Route 11 leaves at :00 and :30 and returns at :10 and :40. Route 15 runs every 15 minutes. Turn back from the saddle at 4:30 and take the 4:52 return. The 5:12 last bus is only a backup
notes.zh: Route 11 每 :00/:30 发、:10/:40 回；Route 15 每 15 分钟， 4:30 鞍部回头，坐 4:52 回程，5:12 末班只当备用

notes.en: The chapel is open 9–5, last entry 4:45. The lot has 45 spaces. If it is full, drop off at the top of the hill
notes.zh: Chapel 每天 9–5（最后入场 4:45）；停车只有 45 位，满了就坡顶下客

notes.en: If the rock is wet or icy, skip the scramble on Cathedral Rock and do not climb the slickrock into Subway Cave
notes.zh: 路湿/结冰：Cathedral Rock 不上攀岩段、Subway Cave 不爬滑石坡

notes.en: Parking: the small Forest Service lot, about 25–36 spaces, is outside the Enchantment Resort gate. If it is full, park on the Boynton Pass Rd shoulder with the car fully off the pavement, or at the Fay Canyon trailhead, then walk 0.7 miles along the road, about 15 minutes each way
notes.zh: 停车：Forest Service 小停车场（约 25–36 位）在 Enchantment Resort 大门外；满了 → 停 Boynton Pass Rd 路肩（车完全离开路面）或 Fay Canyon TH，再沿路走 0.7 mi（+15 分钟/单程）

notes.en: Do not sit down for breakfast. Pack a grab-and-go the night before, from the hotel or a market: bars, fruit, and coffee. Bring 1.5 L of water each
notes.zh: 早餐不坐下吃：前一晚备好酒店/超市 grab-and-go（能量棒、水果、咖啡），水每人 1.5 L

notes.en: No drones. Boynton Canyon Trail and Subway Cave are in the Red Rock–Secret Mountain Wilderness. Federal wilderness rules prohibit takeoff, landing, and flying. The lot is on the boundary. Do not launch from the parking lot either
notes.zh: 无人机：Boynton Canyon 步道和 Subway Cave 都在 Red Rock–Secret Mountain Wilderness 内，联邦 Wilderness 规定禁止起飞/降落/操作（停车场边界紧贴，也别在停车场起飞）

notes.en: Drive back at 9:30 to catch the 10:00 Route 11. If you finish early, take the 9:30 bus
notes.zh: 9:30 一定往回开（赶 10:00 Route 11）；早点下来就坐 9:30 班

title.en: Detour on AZ-179 and I-17 to Flagstaff, then the South Rim: Mather, Trail of Time, El Tovar, Desert View Watchtower, Lipan Point at sunset, dinner at Cameron, then Page
title.zh: AZ-179 → I-17 绕行 → Flagstaff → 大峡谷南缘（Mather · Trail of Time · El Tovar · Desert View 塔楼 · Lipan Point 日落）→ Cameron 晚餐 → Page

notes.en: Check out and leave at 7:15. Bags go in the car the night before. Check az511.gov for road conditions before leaving
notes.zh: 退房出发 7:15（行李前一晚装好车）；出发前看 az511.gov 路况

segments.to: Macy's European Coffeehouse (AZ-179 → I-17 绕行)

note.zh: 89A E → Y 环岛右转 AZ-179 S 15 mi → I-17 N（Exit 298）43 mi → Milton Rd → 市中心 Beaver St。 SR 89A Oak Creek Canyon MP 387–390 无限期封闭（ADOT），不能走 89A；市中心路边计时/免费小停车场

notes.en: Takeout breakfast, 15 minutes. It opens at 6:30 AM. Eat in the car
notes.zh: 早餐外带 15 分钟（6:30 AM 开），车上吃

hours.zh: 官网：周五–周日 6:30 AM–4 PM

text.zh: House-roasted coffee / Cafe Mexicano（cappuccino+肉桂肉豆蔻）
French cinnamon roll（柜台糕点，以当天为准）
Breakfast Sandwich（croissant + steamed eggs）
Biscuit & Gravy（素食 gravy，本地招牌）
Chilaquiles（red / green / Christmas sauce，可加 chorizo）
Egg bagel（早餐蛋贝果）
Deli Sandwich

segments.to: Grand Canyon Visitor Center lots (via South Entrance)

note.zh: Humphreys St → US-180 N（Kendrick Park 林区）→ AZ-64 N 过 Tusayan → 南入口约 10:20 到（含排队 10:50 停好车）。用年票走最左边 Lane 1（持票车道，排队较短）；出发前看 NPS 南入口摄像头。时间表已留 25 分钟排队缓冲 → 跟 Visitor Center 标志停 Lot 1–4
Visitor Center 广场往北 400 m 到 Mather Point 栏杆平台

notes.en: First look at the canyon: walk from the Visitor Center to the Mather Point rail. If you are not at Mather by 11:00, take the Blue bus to the Village and skip the Trail of Time
notes.zh: 第一眼大峡谷：从 Visitor Center 走到 Mather Point 栏杆平台（11:00 前没到 Mather → 改坐 Blue 巴士去 Village，不走 Trail of Time）

text.en: A point of rock over the canyon, facing O'Neill Butte
text.zh: 伸出峡谷的岩岬平台，正对 O'Neill Butte

text.en: Looking down toward Bright Angel Canyon
text.zh: 向下望 Bright Angel Canyon 方向

text.en: The first view, with no sense of scale
text.zh: 第一次看峡谷的'没有尺度感'

note.zh: Rim Trail 往西 1.1 km（平坦铺装）

notes.en: Geology museum windows and outdoor Yavapai Point. Keep it to 10 minutes
notes.zh: 地质馆大玻璃窗+室外 Yavapai Point（缩短到 10 分钟）

hours.en: Open in the daytime. In November about 8–6

text.en: A short stretch of the Colorado River visible through the big window
text.zh: 大窗看得到谷底 Colorado River 一小段

text.en: The relief model that explains the canyon
text.zh: 立体地形模型看懂峡谷结构

note.zh: Rim Trail 'Trail of Time' 往西 2.4 km 到 Grand Canyon Village（每 1 m 代表 100 万年）→ Verkamp's → Hopi House

notes.en: Before lunch: Hopi House next to El Tovar, then west to Lookout Studio on the rim. Optional. Skip it if the line is long or you are behind
notes.zh: 午餐前：Hopi House（El Tovar 隔壁）→ 往西到崖边 Lookout Studio（可选，排队/落后就跳过）

hours.en: Open in the daytime. Shops reopen gradually from 11/20
hours.zh: 日间开放（店铺 11/20 起陆续恢复）

text.en: Hopi House, designed by Mary Colter in 1905
text.zh: Mary Colter 设计的 Hopi House（1905）

text.en: Lookout Studio, a stone room hanging on the rim
